confirmed_defects_and_proposed_resolutio.resolution: Preserved exact original false assertion in fs-shin-global-holder-dirichlet-claim and immutable before carrier; native sector counterexample unchanged. Main corrected theorem proves localC2alpha+Cclosure existence, stability, zero-boundary finite energy, dimension1 Volterra branch, and full smooth-boundary global branch via new complete kernel/geometry helper.

New bounded-open Sobolev triple, Gaussian-kernel Schauder, weak approximants/classical bootstrap/exterior-ball and initial barriers, and zero-data energy identification give the full stated variable-coefficient classical existence/stability scope. Heat-only result is not used as an existence supplier.

Retain equal-count refutation. New occupied-cell averaging proves uniform residual and boundary convergence with the exact regularizers and no balance assumption; squared uniform rate O(Ar+Ab), source count condition specializes to O(mr^-alpha/D).

Preserve exact source quantifier and refutation. Explicit small-scale family, exact count/radius thresholds, independently normalized hit probability, c<=1 comparison and cube example prove a nonvacuous corrected interface.

Source and actual definitions put biu under both i,j sums, conflicting with their own expanded coefficients. Active formulas now separate sumij Di(aijDju)+sumi Di(biu); original printed formula retained visibly. All energy/PDE/PINN consumers reviewed and repaired.

Construct zero-boundary elliptic/parabolic errors in H1_0/energy class; broaden parabolic energy lemma to variational class with actual local energy-pairing supplier. Stopped cylinders tau<T repair unsupported final-face derivative in old maximum-principle proof.

State union-bound probability for arbitrary mutually coupled streams and product only when streams are independent; nested-stream occupancy failures summable at every integer count, so arbitrary count-pair paths are covered.
